ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels occupy approximately 85% of the visible fluke surface, with low-intensity black pixels localized at the perimeter and central notch area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The central fluke area consists of a contiguous white field. Black pigmentation forms a continuous band along the trailing edge and distal tips. A dense, dark focal blob is situated at the central notch insertion. Multiple low-intensity circular spots are scattered across the white interior field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch, approximately 35-40 degrees, with a deep vertex point relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth pattern along the trailing edge with pixel-amplitude variations of approximately 5-12 units relative to a smoothed boundary line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curve fitted to the posterior boundary of both lobes, tapering to sharp distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially discrete, roughly circular dark/brownish clusters observed in the interior white regions of both lobes, corresponding to previous barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark vertical linear feature on the inner left lobe; several faint dark horizontal linear marks detected on the central right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of circular pitted markers (likely parasitic or cookiecutter shark scars) and a clear vertical linear scar on the lower left lobe quadrant.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dark, roughly circular pigment zone surrounding the median notch junction.
